settings.title: Wear black, white and chrome.
settings.text: That is the whole palette. Everything on file is one of the three, or a mix of them, and it all works together.

settings.title: Keep every run small.
settings.text: We make pieces in small runs on purpose. When a size sells through it is gone, and some pieces do not come back. Sold-out assets stay in the register, marked out of stock, so you can see what you missed instead of wondering.

settings.title: Build everything to mix.
settings.text: Tops are cut relaxed and run true to size; go up if you are between sizes. Layer them, tuck them, chain them. Rings come in sizes. Hardware, objects and details are there to catch the light, not to match anything.

settings.title: Deliver.
settings.text: The store’s address is Regina, Saskatchewan, Canada, and it delivers to {countries} countries, Nigeria and Canada among them. The full list is on the Extraction routes page. Prices are in Canadian dollars.

settings.title: No colour of the month.
settings.text: No seasonal palette, no trend colour. Black, white and chrome, every drop.

settings.title: Between sizes? Go up.
settings.text: Tops have a relaxed cut and run true to size. Not sure? Message us before you order.

settings.title: Sold out means sold out.
settings.text: Some pieces return and some do not. We will not pretend either way.

settings.title: Nothing needs a matching partner.
settings.text: Layer it, tuck it, chain it. It is all the same three finishes.

settings.title: Photographs are filed in black and white.
settings.text: That is the brand. Hold your cursor over a photograph (or press and hold on a phone) to declassify the colour it was shot in. It is the only colour on the site.
